title: Prices Tell You How Many Coins

screens.penny: Hi, {name}! Today we'll read prices like a pro.

screens.title: What a price is

cards.caption: A price tag says how much money a thing costs.
A price of 4 means you give 4 coins.

screens.penny: The number on the tag is the price, {name}.

screens.prompt: A kite's tag says 6. How much does the kite cost?
screens.pennyHint: Look at the number on the tag, {name}.
screens.rightMessage: Yes, {name}! A 6 on the tag means 6 coins, and no more.
screens.wrongMessage: Good try, {name}! The tag says 6. You only pay 6, not everything.

screens.prompt: The kite costs 6 coins. Tap 6 coins to pay.
screens.wrongMessage: Good try, {name}! The tag says 6. Count the coins again.
screens.retryIntro: Let's count for that kite again, {name}.

screens.story: Amara has 4 coins. The teddy bear's tag says 7.
screens.pennyHint: Compare 4 coins with a price of 7, {name}.

options.label: Save 3 more coins first
options.outcome: Amara saves 3 more coins. Now she has 7, and the bear is hers.

options.label: Pay 4 coins and take the bear
options.outcome: The tag says 7. 4 coins is not enough yet.

options.label: Change the tag to say 4
options.outcome: The shop set that price. Tags are not ours to change.

screens.rightMessage: Yes, {name}! 4 is less than 7. Three more coins gets her there.
screens.wrongMessage: Good try, {name}! The bear costs 7. Amara has 4, so she needs 3 more.

screens.prompt: You have 10 coins. A book's tag says 8. Is that enough?
screens.rightMessage: Yes, {name}! 10 is more than 8. You pay 8 and keep 2.
screens.wrongMessage: Good try, {name}! 10 coins is more than 8 coins. You have enough.
screens.retryIntro: One more look, {name}. Is 10 more than 8?

screens.title: Nice work, {name}!
screens.message: A price is just a number of coins. You can read it now.
